final_message:
I've written the antitrust review memo of the draft NDA (about 10,000 words). It opened cleanly when parsed back and passed the docx validation script. It recommends not signing the NDA as drafted, flags 20 issues by severity (7 Critical), and adds a clean team / compliance annex term sheet, replacement clause language and a team do's-and-don'ts list.

The Critical issues are the mandatory and quarterly exchange of pricing, customer and capacity data (§§ 6.1–6.2), the lack of any clean team (§§ 1.6, 4.1), the residuals clause (§§ 1.7, 5.3), the waiver of antitrust claims (§ 9.3), the monthly executive meetings (§ 6.3), and the overlap with the Northwind bid.
